tools.title: AI tools
tools.intro: AI only suggests: nothing is changed or published without your confirmation. Always check the results.
tools.aiOff: AI is unavailable (Ollama is not running or the model is not loaded). The rest of the admin works as usual.

ocr.none: OCR unavailable: Tesseract is not installed and no vision model is configured

analysis.title: Document analysis
analysis.noText: The document has no recognised text: AI saw the description only.
analysis.applied: Saved (version {version}): {fields}. The document keeps its publication status.

ocrPanel.title: Text recognition (OCR)

reasons.no_engine: Tesseract is not installed and no vision model is configured
reasons.unsupported_type: only images are supported (JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP)

ocrPanel.applied: Text saved. It enters search only if the file is open to the public.

annotation.title: “Briefly about the document” annotation
annotation.hint: Built only from the public description and the text of open files. It appears on the document card after you approve it, marked as AI.
annotation.approve: Approve and show on the site
annotation.withdraw: Remove from the site and delete
annotation.withdrawText: The annotation will disappear from the document card.
annotation.fileText: File text was used: the annotation is hidden if the files stop being open.

collection.title: Thematic selection draft
collection.intro: AI picks public documents on a topic and suggests a title and description. The draft is not saved anywhere: staff create the collection in the Memory section.
collection.topicPlaceholder: For example: building bridges over the Irtysh

analytics.title: Site analytics
analytics.intro: Search data without personal data: no users, no IPs. Names, e-mails and numbers in queries are masked; queries asked only once are not shown.
analytics.forbidden: The Analyst role or an administrator is required to view analytics.
analytics.zeroQueries: Queries without results (what the site lacks)
analytics.staleTitle: Pages not updated for over a year
analytics.views: Page views are not collected (the site has no trackers), so they are not part of the report.

rec.few_data: Little data so far: conclusions are preliminary.
rec.improve_zero_results: {rate}% of queries return nothing: check synonyms and document descriptions.
rec.review_ai_questions: Review the AI assistant questions: {count} recurring topics.

ai.title: AI conclusion
ai.off: AI is unavailable now — use the recommendations above.

errors.ai_unavailable: AI is unavailable now (Ollama is not running, the model is not loaded or busy). Try later.
errors.not_public: The document is not published or its description is not public.
errors.no_source_text: The document has no public text for an annotation.
errors.unknown_tag: One of the tags was not found.
errors.no_materials: No public materials found for the topic.
errors.version_conflict: The document was changed elsewhere. Run the analysis again.
